tasks.title: Define and Create Events Database Schema in Appwrite
tasks.description: Implement the 'events' collection in Appwrite with all specified fields and types.
tasks.details:
Use Appwrite console or API to create 'events' collection. Define all fields as per PRD, including nested objects and enums. Add calculated fields for capacity.
<info added on 2025-10-05T09:03:40.043Z>
Events database schema implementation complete. Added scripts/setup-events-collection.js to automate creation of the 'events' collection with all 30+ PRD-specified attributes, proper permissions, and 7 indexes (published, featured, eventType, city, eventDate, bookingStatus, slug). JSON fields (pricing, capacity, gallery, includes, etc.) are handled. TypeScript types (src/types/event.ts) define the complete Event interface, enums, helper types, and utility functions for capacity and status calculations. Event service (src/services/eventService.ts) provides full CRUD, advanced filtering, booking operations, view tracking, and automatic status management. Example event script (scripts/add-example-event.js) demonstrates all field types and structures. All files are ready for Appwrite collection creation and integration.
</info added on 2025-10-05T09:03:40.043Z>
tasks.testStrategy: Create, read, update, and delete event documents via Appwrite dashboard and API. Validate schema constraints.

tasks.title: Implement Events CRUD API Endpoints
tasks.description: Develop Next.js API routes for creating, reading, updating, and deleting events.
tasks.details:
Create RESTful endpoints under /api/events. Validate input against schema. Integrate with Appwrite SDK for database operations. Implement authentication for admin routes.
<info added on 2025-10-05T09:18:19.847Z>
Implementation of the Events CRUD API endpoints is complete, with seven RESTful API routes created under /api/events. These routes include full filtering and pagination support for listing events, creation, retrieval, update, and deletion of events, as well as specialized routes for featured and upcoming events. All endpoints feature proper error handling, type-safe request/response handling, and JSON response format with a success flag. Integration with the eventService has been implemented. However, admin authentication remains pending for the admin-only routes. Unit and integration tests are required to ensure the functionality and reliability of these endpoints. Testing should include validation of API responses using tools like Postman and integration with the frontend.
</info added on 2025-10-05T09:18:19.847Z>
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit and integration tests for all endpoints. Test with Postman and frontend integration.

tasks.title: Create Admin Events Management Page
tasks.description: Develop /admin/events for CRUD operations, capacity management, and stats.
tasks.details:
Implement authentication/authorization. List events, allow create/edit/delete, manage bookings and capacity, display quick stats.
<info added on 2025-10-05T10:04:43.468Z>
Admin Events Management page implementation complete:

Created comprehensive admin interface in src/app/admin/events/page.tsx with the following features:

Dashboard displays five stat cards (Total Events, Published, Drafts, Upcoming, Sold Out) with color-coded icons and gradients, updating stats in real time from events data.

Filtering system includes Published/Drafts/All filter buttons, event type and city dropdowns, and real-time API-integrated filtering.

Events table features columns for Event (with type icon), Date & Time, Venue, Capacity (with general/VIP breakdown), Price (general + VIP), Status, and Actions. Booking status badges (Open/Limited/Sold Out), published/draft toggle buttons, and row hover effects are included.

Action buttons allow viewing (new tab), editing (navigate to edit page), deleting (with confirmation), and toggling published status inline.

Additional features: admin authentication check with redirect, loading states, empty state with "Create First Event" CTA, Create Event button in header, responsive table design, integration with AdminLayout, color-coded UI, and real-time stats updates.

Note: Edit and Create pages are required for full CRUD and can be added later.
</info added on 2025-10-05T10:04:43.468Z>
tasks.testStrategy: Test all admin actions, permissions, and data integrity.
